qdc_qhc_relationship.summary: Part 1.6 / Table 1.6.1 nominates Dwelling house code PO1/AO1 and PO2/AO2 as alternative provisions to QDC MP1.2 road boundary setbacks and PO3/AO3 as alternative provisions to QDC MP1.2 side and rear boundary clearances (Building Act s32(c) and s33). All three are limited to the Rural zone (AO1 and AO3 exclude the Gemfields precincts; AO2 applies to the Gemfields precincts only). No zone code contains setbacks. Everywhere else the QDC applies. The scheme does not mention the Queensland Housing Code.

quotes.text: This planning scheme, through Part 5 (Tables of assessment) and this subsection, regulates building work in accordance with sections 32 and 33 of the Building Act 1975.
specifying alternative boundary clearances and site cover provisions for particular Class 1 and Class 10 structures under section 33 of the Building Act 1975 (alternative provisions).

Section 32(c) and section 33 of the Building Act 1975 | Alternative provisions to QDC part MP1.2 road boundary setbacks | Section 8.3.5 Dwelling house code PO1 and AO1; PO2 and AO2 || Alternative provisions to QDC part MP1.2 side and rear boundary clearances | Section 8.3.5 Dwelling house code PO3 and AO3

Note—the performance outcomes of this code and the corresponding acceptable outcomes are in addition to the mandatory Queensland Development Code (QDC) provisions and nominate the application of certain provisions, any alternative qualitative statements or quantitative standards for the purposes of section 6 of the Building Regulation 2021, and any alternative provisions made under section 33 of the Building Act 1975.

Note—The provisions of this code apply to single detached dwellings (Class 1), other Class 1 dwellings involving dwelling houses that have a self-contained secondary dwelling and associated Class 10 domestic outbuildings and structures.

definitions.text: Domestic outbuilding | means a non-habitable class 10a building that is— a shed, garage or carport; and ancillary to a residential use carried out on the premises where the building is.
Class 10a building | non-habitable buildings including sheds, carports, and private garages.

Setback | for a building or structure, means the shortest distance, measured horizontally, between the outermost projection of the building or structure to the vertical projection of the boundary of the lot where the building or structure is.

Boundary clearance | means the distance between a building or structure on premises and the boundary of the premises, measured from the part of the building or structure that is closest to the boundary, other than a part that is— an architectural or ornamental attachment; or a rainwater fitting.

Dwelling house | means a residential use of premises involving— one dwelling and any domestic outbuildings associated with the dwelling; or two dwellings, one of which is a secondary dwelling, and any domestic outbuildings associated with either dwelling.

Minor building work | means building work that increases the gross floor area of a building by no more than the lesser of the following— 50m2; an area equal to 5% of the gross floor area of the building.

rules.verbatim_text: Frontage setbacks for buildings and structures || PO1 Where located in the Rural zone (excluding the Gemfields precincts), a dwelling house is set back from any road frontage to:- maintain an open or mostly open rural landscape; protect the natural rural landscape character and amenity; protect the safe and efficient functioning of the State and local road networks. | AO1 In the Rural zone (excluding the Gemfields precincts) the dwelling house is set back at least:- 100m from a State controlled road frontage; and 20m from any other road frontage.

local_plan_mechanism.summary: Part 1.2 states "there are no local plans". Zone precincts: Medium density residential precinct (General residential zone); Gemfields Core, Gemfields Frame and Gemfields Balance precincts (Rural zone). Part 9 notes the Blackwater and Blackwater East Priority Development Areas (Economic Development Act 2012) override the scheme; council is consulting on revoking them (ePlan news, submissions to 10 April 2026).

open_questions: Do Dwelling house code AO1-AO3 (worded "the dwelling house") reach detached Class 10a outbuildings? Headings say "buildings and structures", the use definition of Dwelling house includes domestic outbuildings, and the code note says it applies to associated Class 10 domestic outbuildings - treated as in scope, needs curator confirmation.
AO2 (Gemfields) says "is set back 10m/6m" rather than "at least"; assumed a minimum.
Rural-zone (non-Gemfields) Class 10a buildings are accepted development with no planning requirements (Table 5.6.1), but AO1/AO3 still bind as building assessment provisions via Table 1.6.1.
Blackwater PDA areas are outside the scheme until revocation.
